definitions.explanation: A device used to measure physical quantities such as temperature, pressure, distance, or weight. Covers a broad range from simple gauges to sophisticated electronic instruments.

examples.japanese: {計測器|けいそくき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{精度|せいど}→精度：13787_seido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: Check the accuracy of the measuring instrument.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{計測器|けいそくき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{温度|おんど}→温度：00333_ondo⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{湿度|しつど}→湿度：03181_shitsudo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{同時|どうじ}→同時：01592_douji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{測|はか}れる→測る：01977_hakaru⟧。
examples.english: This measuring instrument can measure temperature and humidity simultaneously.

examples.english: By introducing new measuring instruments, inspection time was significantly reduced.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{計測|けいそく}→計測：14189_keisoku⟧ (measurement) and {器|き} (instrument, device). Used broadly in scientific, industrial, and technical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {計測器|けいそくき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{精度|せいど}→精度：13787_seido⟧: accuracy of a measuring instrument
- {計測器|けいそくき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{校正|こうせい}→校正：21081_kousei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to calibrate a measuring instrument
- {計測器|けいそくき}⟦メーカー→メーカー：11158_meekaa⟧: measuring instrument manufacturer
- ⟦{電子|でんし}→電子：03449_denshi⟧{計測器|けいそくき}: electronic measuring instrument

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{測定器|そくていき}→測定器：30039_sokuteiki⟧: measuring device — largely synonymous but slightly more common in everyday technical use
- ⟦{計器|けいき}→計器：03946_keiki⟧: gauge, meter — typically refers to instruments built into equipment (dashboards, cockpits)
- ⟦センサー→センサー：29781_sensaa⟧: sensor — detects a specific physical quantity but may not display the reading directly
